shortDescription: Exxon Mobil NYSE:XOM and its partners in Angola's offshore Block 15 have taken a final investment decision on a $4 billion redevelopment of the Kizomba A and B fields and made a hydrocarbon discovery in an exploration well, Angola's National Oil, Gas and Biofuels Agency (ANPG) said on Friday.

children: and its partners in Angola's offshore Block 15 have taken a final investment decision on a $4 billion redevelopment of the Kizomba A and B fields and made a hydrocarbon discovery in an exploration well, Angola's National Oil, Gas and Biofuels Agency (ANPG) said on Friday.
The discovery at the Tchihumba West-01ST1, is the 21st in Block 15 and the second this year, was made in one of Angola's most prolific deepwater oil-producing areas

The well, located about 350 km (217.48 miles) northwest of the capital Luanda, was drilled to a water depth of 1,400 metres (4593.18 ft) and encountered around 65.4 metres of sandstone containing hydrocarbons with good petrophysical properties, ANPG said in a statement

"With support from the extension of the Block 15 production sharing agreement through 2037 and nearly $4 billion in planned new investments, we are well positioned to continue generating value for Angola, our partners and our shareholders," said Brian Unietis, Director General of ExxonMobil Angola

Angola, Sub-Saharan Africa's second-biggest crude oil producer after Nigeria, has undertaken a major regulatory overhaul to encourage exploration investment as it seeks to maintain production levels amid mature offshore fields
